known_local_policies: Original completed physical hand PlayRecords select card kinds, including countered plays and a minion that dies during its Battlecry; automatic CAST and effect summons do not become physical card plays.

Rat Trap original third-play prefix is reused. Health consumers use each original captured packet and current original source residence; Reckoning needs a still-live enemy minion after at least3 actual damage.
Avenge observes a real owner minion death and selects current living friendly survivors. Ordinary random hand buff keeps empty-hand Secret unconsumed.

Open the Cages checks at least two controlled living friendly minions, including dormant bodies and ordinary board capacity, then uses the original shared Animal Companion producer, family revision and additional-companion policy; all three original native bodies remain unchanged.

Bargain Bin matching slot order is minion, spell, weapon with the original played kind omitted. Original matching physical draw, empty-match and overflow behavior remain shared; exact official order is uncalibrated.

Evasion starts after actual hero damage and grants the ordinary current-turn immunity; source/control/reveal and atomic health-batch reaction boundaries remain local policies. Complete72 scope and WON_040 stay closed.
